name: Postgres.js
solves: Provides a fast, full-featured PostgreSQL client for Node.js, Deno, Bun, and Cloudflare Workers with tagged-template SQL, transactions, and cursors — a database driver and SQL client, not an ORM or query-builder framework.
best_for: PostgreSQL-only apps that want a minimal, very fast SQL client
Edge, Bun, or Deno runtimes where classic `pg` is awkward
Teams writing tagged-template SQL with good ergonomics and safety
Services that pair a thin client with Drizzle or Kysely, or hand-written SQL
High-throughput APIs sensitive to client overhead
skip_when: You need an ORM with models, relations, and migrations — use Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM, or Sequelize
You need a multi-dialect query builder — use Knex, Kysely, or Drizzle
You are on MySQL, SQLite, or SQL Server rather than Postgres
You prefer the node-postgres (`pg`) ecosystem and middleware already in your stack
You want schema-first generated clients (Prisma) rather than hand-written SQL
